semiconductor_relevance: High — The company produces quartz glass products critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Beijing Kaide Quartz Corporation is a key supplier of quartz glass products used in semiconductor manufacturing. They specialize in producing quartz wares such as boats and tubes, which are essential consumables for integrated circuit chip production lines ranging from 4-inch to 12-inch.
capabilities: Quartz tubes with diameters up to 600mm
